svg.title: Terminal cancellation does not complete admitted accesses
svg.desc: Six slots × 512 bytes; initial O/R/H/U = 3/1/1/1; constructed times only
svg.text: Terminal cancellation does not complete admitted accesses
Six slots × 512 bytes; initial O/R/H/U = 3/1/1/1; constructed times only
t = 0 ms: close A and release its unused credit
Detach A edges from shared slot 0 and private slots 1 and 2.
O/R/H/U = 3/0/1/2. Both A access completions are still outstanding.
t = 2 ms: A read completes across slots 0 and 1
Discharge two reader pins; return private slot 1 once.
O/R/H/U = 2/0/1/3. Slot 0 keeps B/cache ownership and B reader pin.
t = 7 ms: A writer completes on private slot 2
Discharge writer pin; return slot 2 once; A is Clean.
O/R/H/U = 1/0/1/4. Shared source remains occupied by surviving owners.
Duplicates at 1, 3 and 8 ms repeat no resource effect
Two physical returns = 1,024 bytes; one credit release is separate.
Cancellation acknowledgement at 0 ms does not establish safe return; constructed drain delay is 7 ms.
